notes.en:
## New Features

- Add a native Windows backend manager with a system tray, settings window, bilingual controls, startup diagnostics and DPI-aware layout. Compiled Windows applications start in the tray; starting the executable again reopens the frontend, while --serve keeps direct server mode.
- Unify request evidence in the request recorder, with separate request/response ring budgets, manual or automatic pinning, diagnostics and downloads from usage history and error dialogs.

## Improvements

- Hot-reload settings-file changes, follow the actual listener address in the manager, and honor the configured frontend opening mode.
- Avoid console flashes from Windows background commands and improve browser/app opening, Explorer windows and IPv6 address handling.
- Bound release ancestry-comparison output to keep CI preflight responses small.

## Fixes

- Make reused subagents resumed by Send or recovery register as background tasks consistently, so Await and Stop observe the new run instead of stale results. Ensure Await after Send waits for delivery acceptance first.
- Fix composer document/file-reference mismatches after reference capture and restore multipart-normalized line endings.
- Move through visual lines with the up/down arrow keys before browsing input history at the first or last visual line.
- Handle message-document version changes during live writes with a structural reload, and accept exact-layout pages when their requested window remains unchanged.

## Upgrade Notes

- Published to the beta / prerelease channel under the default version rules. Reuses executor-v0.9.3 and helpers-v1.0.0.
- Legacy request dumps and historical Token repair data are removed, not migrated. Existing request-dump settings are mapped to request-evidence settings. Export any needed legacy evidence before upgrading.
- The SQLite migration rewrites the api_requests table and may take time on large databases. Reclaimed space is returned to disk only after manually running VACUUM in storage settings.
notes.zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 新增 Windows 原生后端管理器，提供系统托盘、设置窗口、中英文界面、启动诊断与 DPI 缩放。编译版 Windows 程序默认从托盘启动，再次运行可重新打开前端；--serve 保留直接启动服务的方式。
- 请求证据统一使用请求录制器，支持请求与响应独立循环预算、手动或自动固定保存，以及从使用历史和错误弹窗查看诊断、下载证据。

## 改进

- 配置文件修改可热重载，管理器跟随实际监听地址，并遵循前端打开方式设置。
- 减少 Windows 后台命令的控制台闪窗，改善浏览器与应用模式打开、资源管理器窗口及 IPv6 地址处理。
- 限制发布流程祖先比较的输出大小，避免 CI 预检响应过大。

## 修复

- 通过 Send 或恢复机制续跑的子代理统一登记为后台任务，Await 与 Stop 正确识别本轮运行，不再读取旧结果；Send 后的 Await 先等待消息接收完成。
- 修复引用捕获后输入框文档与文件引用不匹配，并还原 multipart 传输规范化的换行。
- 输入框上下方向键优先移动视觉行，到首行或末行后再翻阅输入历史。
- 消息实时写入导致文档版本变化时正确触发结构重载；请求窗口未变化时仍可接收精确排版分页。

## 升级说明

- 本版本按默认规则发布到 beta / prerelease 通道，继续复用 executor-v0.9.3 与 helpers-v1.0.0。
- 旧请求 dump 与历史 Token 核对数据将被移除，不做迁移；原请求 dump 设置自动映射为请求证据设置。升级前请导出仍需保留的旧证据。
- SQLite 迁移会重写 api_requests 表，大数据库升级可能耗时；释放的空间需在储存设置中手动执行 VACUUM 后才会归还磁盘。
